title: EnergyCal: Taming Loss Spikes in Muon-Family Optimizers for Sparse MoE Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.37062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.

translated_title: EnergyCal：在稀疏MoE训练中驯服Muon系列优化器的损失尖峰
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型在使用Muon系列优化器训练时可能出现较大的损失尖峰。我们提出了EnergyCal，这是一种轻量级规则，根据路由专家更新的有限步Newton-Schulz方向的归一化平方Frobenius范数来衰减这些更新。EnergyCal保持谱变换不变，且不增加任何持久化的优化器状态。我们在一个40亿参数的MoE模型上对其进行了评估。与通过开发调优选定的较低学习率MuonH方案相比，EnergyCal-MuonH将平均阈值化损失尖峰负担降低了99.51%，最终几何平均困惑度降低了4.06%，吞吐量代价适中。在使用普通Muon并匹配标称学习率和权重衰减的情况下，在测试的两个指数上，平均尖峰负担的降低平均达到95.98%，并伴随终点指标的小幅改善。这些发现在所评估的设置中，支持了无论是否使用Hyperball的稳定化效果。
tldr: EnergyCal是一种轻量级规则，通过根据Newton-Schulz方向的归一化平方Frobenius范数衰减路由专家更新，可将稀疏MoE训练中的损失尖峰负担降低高达99.51%并改善困惑度，同时不改变谱变换、不增加持久优化器状态。
en_tdlr: EnergyCal is a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions, reducing mean loss-spike burden by up to 99.51% in sparse MoE training while improving perplexity, without altering the spectral transform or adding persistent optimizer state.
